reason: Final pre-FORMAL measurement closure after external and internal review. The changes clarify RQ1 identity, add non-primary route diagnostics, pre-specify the RQ3 statistical analysis, fix the RQ3 bank size/allocation, and make the shared-Expert-A validity threat explicit.

changes.change: Define screen name as the visible in-screen title/header. Keep module, screen and screen_hierarchy as the primary dimensions. Add screen_route/title/hierarchy diagnostics for interpretation only.
Fix final bank at 54 query_ids, 6 per each of nine strata; 216 primary blinded responses.

Freeze exact McNemar tests for the two primary binary paired comparisons, Holm correction across them, paired query-level bootstrap intervals, and a secondary Wilcoxon latency sensitivity analysis. Strata remain descriptive.
Explicitly identify correlated epistemic dependence because Expert A builds independent references/validates the bank and is the primary blind RQ3 scorer.
